title: Compact cost tiles: color-blind palette + locale-aware numeric formatting prototype review
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create and review a compact card/tile layout for the cost explorer and rollouts list that simultaneously addresses color-blind accessible palettes, WCAG contrast for small text, and locale-aware numeric formatting (grouping, decimal separators, compact units). Prototype should show three density states (compact, default, expanded) and include aria announcements for dynamic value updates and locale fallback behavior when user locale is unsupported.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype includes compact/default/expanded tile variants with design tokens for color, typography, and spacing
Color palette validated for deuteranopia/protanopia/tritanopia using simulated snapshots and meets 4.5:1 contrast for primary numeric values
Numeric values render correctly for en-US, de-DE, ja-JP, and fr-FR locales; fallback behavior documented when locale data missing
Keyboard focus order and visible focus rings for tiles and inline controls pass manual review
Design token names and examples provided for engineering handoff (tokens for number-format style, unit compacting, and color roles)
Prototype includes example ARIA live-region behavior for incremental cost updates and a short screen-reader script to validate announcements
comments: 2025-02-18 | Aisha Patel: Kicked off scoping — goal is to reduce per-row height by 30% for the cost explorer while preserving clarity for numbers and status chips. Asked ENG to stub locale formatting util and to produce colorblind simulation exports.

2025-02-19 | Marco Liu: Prototype v1 uploaded. Key trade-offs: compact spacing reduces leading which makes small numbers slightly harder to read. Proposed stronger weight for token 'text-strong' on numeric values. Requesting accessibility pass from Sofia.

2025-02-20 | Sofia Ramirez (a11y reviewer): Ran colorblind sims — suggested swapping yellow highlight for an amber with higher luminance and adjusting status chip border to increase contrast. Keyboard nav works but focus ring was clipped in compact mode; needs token adjustment.

2025-02-21 | Jordan Blake (PM): Confirmed required locales for initial rollout. Request: support compact unit suffixes for values >1000 with localization (e.g., 1.2k vs 1,2 Tsd). Also suggested exposing a per-tenant setting to toggle compact numbers.
2025-02-22 | Marco Liu: Updated prototype v2 with new amber token, thicker focus ring, and numeric token 'numeric-compact' added. Pushed engineering ticket ENG-2280 with initial token spec.

2025-02-24 | Aisha Patel: Design review meeting notes — design + eng agreed on token names and ARIA live approach. Outstanding: engineering to validate performance of live-region updates at scale and PM to validate locale fallback UX with legal for specific markets. Marking In Review pending final ENG sign-off.
decision_log: 2025-02-20: Chose accessibility-first palette that sacrifices one accent tone for higher contrast; decision recorded after colorblind and WCAG sim runs.
2025-02-22: Use 'compact unit' formatting variant by default in compact density; allow tenant opt-out via console setting.

2025-02-24: ARIA approach agreed: brief polite live region for incremental updates and assertive announcement only for threshold-crossing events (>10% delta) to avoid verbosity for screen reader users.
